page.layout: One title page, one block of centred type with a printer's ornament below the text block. No margins, running head or page number. Handwriting, a library stamp and a digitiser's watermark are not transcribed.

main_text.l: Christum esse Deum prædituum essentia di-
In Academia Salmuriensi varijs temporibus habitæ,

page.notes: Printer's ornament (a decorative woodcut of foliage) stands between the "Sub Præsidio" lines and the imprint; not text. Handwritten inscription above the ornament and an oval library stamp ("Biblioteca Naz. Roma, Vittorio Emanuele") are excluded as not printed. The "Præsidio" and "PLACÆI" spellings are shown with the printed ligatures (æ, Æ). The printed text reads "prædituum" in the scan's "prædit-um" line break: the scan shows "prædi-" at the line end and "tum" on the next line; the transcription above reads it as printed in the first line. Where the scan's characters were unclear I followed the printed form. The title contains the printed "IOSVE'" with apostrophe, left as printed.
